name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales Activation & Onboarding Leader | Team Leadership, Conversion Quotas, High-Volume Launches
summary: Onboarding and sales leader with 15+ years in SaaS and agency environments and 2+ years leading teams against monthly quotas. At Wix, led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists while personally launching 25+ clients a month to their first sale, the point Wix counted an onboarding as won, at 110% of implementation and 120% of sales targets. Led the sales team at Fetch & Funnel next, and ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. Builds the workflows, automation, and process fixes that move volume through a conversion pipeline faster.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for B2B service clients, translating business requirements into system configurations and delivering hands-on training.
Designed and deployed 20+ automation workflows covering lead qualification, booking, no-show recovery, and onboarding nurture, removing manual steps that slowed conversion.
Build performance dashboards tracking funnel progression, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and report recommendations on a regular cadence.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led multi-stakeholder client accounts, coordinating execution across internal departments and presenting quarterly business reviews to client leadership.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs to drive optimization decisions.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (contracts ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Analyzed partner utilization data to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Sales Team Lead - Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team while carrying an individual book, closing 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (roughly $130K+ in bookings).
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery teams.
Managed work for a banking-industry client and joined the pursuit of a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect, reaching the finalist stage.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery.

Onboarded 25+ clients per month to their first sale (Wix counted an onboarding as won only once the client's first sale was on the books), holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.

Built team processes, hiring, onboarding, and training for a brand-new Wix vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line, and developed sales training for tenured account executives.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Led team initiatives and pitched process improvements to streamline launches, accelerating time-to-value for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps for all but the final months of a 27-month tenure, while quota roughly doubled.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and handed them to the implementation team, carrying sales commitments into delivery.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle, high-volume SMB sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform, from prospecting and qualification through close.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
